relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a woman with a LAMP2 variant: 'Genetic testing identified the LAMP2 c.928G>A (p.Val310Ile) variant.'
method_note: Hand extraction; a Python script only assembled the JSON and the 20 checklist rows. One in-scope person (rule 5 label 'patient'). The Medicina family with c.928+3A>G [13] is described only at family level (no individual-level fact), so it gets no rows. Age at onset recorded as the age at presentation with chest discomfort (42-year-old); age at Danon diagnosis and at last evaluation are not stated as ages (only years 2022/2025, 'Five years later'), so not reported; vital status not stated. Pre-excitation: the baseline ECG 'did not report pre-excitation' and the 2022 ECG had 'no pre-excitation pattern was reported', with the authors stressing tracings could not be re-evaluated; treated as not reported, not excluded. Baseline ECG 'no obvious abnormality' (2017) was not recorded as an excluded feature (whole investigation, later superseded by AF/conduction findings). 'Three short non-sustained ventricular runs' recorded as a feature but the checklist item ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation left not reported (paper does not say tachycardia). Heart failure checklist left not reported: the paper refers to 'advanced heart-failure evaluation/planning' but never states she had heart failure. Dilated/hypokinetic LV checklist marked observed from 'left-ventricular enlargement' (2017) and 'relatively reduced myocardial motion' (2022/2025), although LVEF was preserved (65.0%) in 2017 and not quantifiable later. Skeletal myopathy, cognitive and retinal features were explicitly not screened, so not reported. Alprazolam/quetiapine are listed but no psychiatric diagnosis is stated. Variant type, zygosity and inheritance not stated for this patient; functional validation not performed. No contradictions found.

treatment_summary.value: beta-blocker and diuretic therapy initially; later metoprolol succinate, rivaroxaban, spironolactone, furosemide, potassium chloride, alprazolam as needed and quetiapine; ICD therapy and heart-transplantation evaluation recommended; patient chose pre-transplant assessment in December 2025
span: Initial treatment consisted of beta-blocker and diuretic therapy.

Long-term medical therapy included metoprolol succinate 23.75 mg once daily, rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily, spironolactone 10 mg once daily, furosemide 10 mg once daily, and potassium chloride sustained-release tablets 1000 mg three times daily, with alprazolam as needed and quetiapine at night.
Implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy and renewed heart-transplantation evaluation were recommended.
The patient ultimately chose to proceed with heart-transplantation assessment in December 2025.
